_note: Found 2026-09-08 by searching the pipeline's own verified sources -- ingest/ingest_amex.py's deduped card export (10,271 txns, 2025-02-14..2026-08-27) and data/processed/boa_transactions.csv (147 statements, verified to their own balance delta, 2023-08-30..2026-07-31). Fleet-wide, not split by company -- neither source names which truck or company a SaaS charge belongs to. Rates below are TOTAL DOLLARS / WEEKS IN THE OBSERVED WINDOW for that vendor, never an average of per-charge amounts, per this project's own established convention.

DAT_load_board._note: TWO NON-OVERLAPPING PAYMENT WINDOWS, not summed together: bank ACH ran Jan-Aug 2024 then stops; AMEX card charges start Mar 2025. There is an unexplained gap, Aug 2024-Mar 2025, with no DAT charge found on either rail -- not resolved, not assumed to be zero-cost.

8x8_voip.source: AMEX only, not found on bank

RingCentral.source: AMEX only, not found on bank
RingCentral._note: Only 5.3 months of charges -- looks recently added, possibly alongside or replacing 8x8.

Samsara_recurring._note: This is the FLEET-WIDE recurring AMEX total across ~18 months, separate from the single September 2026 ZONE-OH invoice in telematics_costs.json ($2,308.58) -- the invoice is one month's detail, this is the long-run card total.

Green_Light_ELD_recurring._note: Real payment channel is PayPal, visible on AMEX as 'PAYPAL *GREENLIGHTE'. The 10 bank-ACH hits found ($320.00 total, all within a single 2-week window in April 2025) are almost certainly bank account MICRO-VERIFICATION deposits (Plaid-style), not subscription payments -- do not add them to the ELD run-rate.

Pedigree_recurring._note: Fleet-wide recurring total, separate from the single September 2026 ZONE-OH invoice in telematics_costs.json ($2,781.00).

PrePass_BestPass_recurring.source: bank ACH only, not found on AMEX
PrePass_BestPass_recurring._note: Lower weekly average than the Aug-2026 device-level invoice implies (~$421/wk for that one month) -- consistent with fleet growth over the 2.5-year window, not a contradiction. The device-level invoice is the more current and more precise figure.

bank._note: POSITIVE on the bank feed (money IN) -- likely QuickBooks Payments merchant-processing deposits, not a subscription charge. Sign not yet explained; do not net against the AMEX subscription charges above.

GoDaddy._note: 82 charges over 77 weeks is unusually frequent for domain/hosting renewals -- worth a closer look at what's actually being bought before trusting this as one clean recurring line.
